page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; marginal numbers (4, 5, 6) in the left margin; a partly visible facing page at the right edge (show-through/neighbouring page, not transcribed). Page number at head: (o) ornament, read as "(o)" in the head ornament.

main_text.p: potis & sanguinis appellatione honoris, non naturam mutans, sed gratiam naturae adjiciens, Theodor. dial. 1. qui Greek text Augusti. Epist. 23.

4Quamvis enim sensu, quae dantur, percipiuntur: Spiritualiter tamen dantur, non secundum naturae consequentiam, sed secundum muneris gratiam, & cum corpore etiam animam in fidem adducendo nutriunt, Chrysost. 1. Cor. 10. hom. 22. Greek text inquit Macarius homil. 27.

5Atque hinc fit, ut dum unigeniti Dei, hoc est, Jesu Christi mortem, & ex mortuis resurrectionem annunciamus, ejusdem in coelum assumptionem profitemur, incruentum in Ecclesia Dei cultum obeamus, mysticasque benedictiones adeamus, eaque ratione sanctificemur, utpote sacrae & pretiosi sanguinis Christi omnium nostrum Salvatoris participes effecti, Concil. Ephes.
6Et hic nihil differt sacerdos a subdito, quando fruendum est horrendis mysteriis: similiter enim omnes, ut illa percipiamus, digni habemur. Non sicut in veteri lege

page.notes: Marginal numbers 4, 5, 6 at left. Greek passages are only partly legible in the scan and were not reliably reproduced; the Greek is marked by its position but should be checked against the original. Several words in the right-hand facing page are cut off and not transcribed.
